text:
Deploy Bot: starting canary r-2026-03-15T23Z -> 10% (variant=v3-quant-fast).
Ada R: heads up, post-deploy smoke shows embed-synth p95 up on shadow by ~140ms vs live.
Priya: ugh, can you paste the probe names/ids?
Ada R: probe: synth/embed-short-78, synth/kv-prefill-77. Shadow shows fewer prefill hits.
SRE Oncall: noticed synthetic sender backpressure around 3267004400, some events dropped.
Ken: dropped events would bias comparisons, makes shadow look worse even if real traffic ok.
Lina: any user-facing alerts? metrics look green for external routes.
Ada R: no user errors yet, just the synthetic delta. Live p95 +30ms, shadow +170ms.
Priya: don't want to continue ramping until we confirm parity. Suggest hold and triage.
Deploy Bot: automated canary window 10m, auto-rollback at +30m.
Ada R: temporary mitigation: increased synth sampling on live and shadow at 3267004460 to 2x for 8m to get more signal.
SRE Oncall: investigating shadow controller logs 1 found that prefill feature-flag rollout omitted the shadow namespace.
Ken: that would prevent prefill warmup tasks from enqueuing on shadow nodes.
Lina: plan: flip flag in shadow namespace and re-trigger targeted prefill jobs.
Priya: timeline for flag flip?
SRE Oncall: flipped at 3267004560, enqueued warmup jobs. Watching p95.
Ada R: after flip, shadow p95 started trending down by 3267004680, delta now ~35ms.
Priya: decision: keep canary at 10% paused for 12m hold to validate, do not rollback.
Deploy Bot: rollout manually paused at 3267004580 by Priya; will not auto-advance.
Ken: filing small postmortem note and a quick checkbox in the deploy checklist to verify feature-flag scope includes shadow namespaces.
Lina: also adding a deploy gate metric: synthetic p95 ratio (shadow/live) with threshold 1.25, will open a PR.
SRE Oncall: PR opened for gate and runbook entry at 3267004685.
Ada R: good catch everyone, will post a short debrief when we unpause. :thumbsup:
